requirements.statement: Preserve the two-round, three-question-per-round Survey geometry.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Exactly two rounds of three questions validate and freeze.

requirements.statement: Preserve multi-pick input and distinguish composable from contradictory selections.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Pick normalization preserves composition and declared contradictions.

requirements.statement: Design, validate and freeze all three questions in a round before first disclosure.

acceptanceObligations.statement: A disclosed round cannot mutate its frozen instrument.

requirements.statement: Present and capture one question at a time without preview or inter-pick interpretation.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Every Director question view contains only the current question.

requirements.statement: Prevent Round 2 construction until Round-1 picks and aggregate interpretation are durable.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Round 2 begins only from sealed Round-1 semantic ancestry.

requirements.statement: Preserve raw Director evidence separately from deterministic normalization.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Raw responses and normalized picks survive a session round trip.

requirements.statement: Keep semantic authority with the Director and proposer while validators remain mechanical.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Wrong-role semantic commands and validator ratification fail closed.

requirements.statement: Make final composite ratification the only mandatory Director checkpoint beyond six picks.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Correction, withholding and ratification preserve exact candidate ancestry.

requirements.statement: Model legal protocol behavior in one manifest and an isomorphic normative Mermaid FSM.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Mermaid parse-back exactly matches expanded manifest tuples.

requirements.statement: Provide a complete Director-centred workflow view tied to protocol transition IDs.

acceptanceObligations.statement: The Director FLOW resolves every machine edge and all six question lanes.

requirements.statement: Persist frozen instruments, cursors, authority, picks, interpretations, mappings, dependencies and composites.

acceptanceObligations.statement: The atomic session contains every reached-state artifact and event.

requirements.statement: Resume cold at the exact legal state without regenerating or leaking undisclosed questions.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Cold takeover replays state and exposes only the current legal view.

requirements.statement: Produce one self-contained generated intent envelope as downstream planning input.

acceptanceObligations.statement: A ratified session regenerates one byte-identical self-contained envelope.

requirements.statement: Organize source knowledge into sovereign one-purpose fragments.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Every fragment has one descriptor, payload and purpose.

requirements.statement: Govern recurring structures with versioned strict schemas.

acceptanceObligations.statement: All fourteen schema classes validate offline and reject unknown fields.

requirements.statement: Generate SKILL.md and every runtime projection deterministically from canonical source.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Repeated build and check produce byte-identical registered targets.

requirements.statement: Model external references, skills and triangulation processes as typed dependencies.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Typed dependency hooks resolve, block and retry without semantic injection.

requirements.statement: Implement axiom applicability as the first concrete triangulation-process contract.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Axiom stages bind complete interpretations to one frozen session snapshot.

requirements.statement: Require auditable unique or supporting contribution evidence for every fragment.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Capability removal proves every included fragment contribution.

requirements.statement: Enforce progressive disclosure and explicit context budgets in generated agent surfaces.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Generated surfaces meet line, word, hop and no-preview budgets.

requirements.statement: Characterize v1 and compare v1/v2 behavior without requiring output compatibility.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Root-owned v1 fixtures retain all 17, 12 and 24 baseline assertions.

requirements.statement: Test schemas, composition, projection, protocol, state, dependencies and envelope generation independently.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Registered tests are modular, orthogonal and one behavior each.

requirements.statement: Forward-test with clean agents and require a Director canary before promotion.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Forward fixtures cannot substitute for the separately authorized Director canary.

requirements.statement: Promote atomically under the canonical survey name and retain tested v1 rollback.

acceptanceObligations.statement: Staging fixes name survey while promotion remains an external no-rewrite gate.

requirements.statement: Prevent v2, a validator or a reviewer from supplying Director ratification or self-authorizing promotion.

acceptanceObligations.statement: No package capability can ratify for the Director or promote itself.

requirements.statement: Remove mandatory planning-owned branch, review and compressed-timeline fields from the envelope.

acceptanceObligations.statement: The envelope model has no mandatory planning-owned fields.

requirements.statement: Make the staged skill a complete relocatable sovereign installable root.

acceptanceObligations.statement: A clean non-Git root installs, builds, checks and tests without siblings.

requirements.statement: Represent external Git knowledge by repository name and safe selector with per-session observed bytes.

acceptanceObligations.statement: T41 freezes a stable bounded snapshot without configured refs or content pins.
